name: semantic-compact
description: Suggests running /compact or /clear when a new task begins: task-boundary detection on every prompt, reminder only — never auto-compacts.

JEV_PROVIDER.title: Jev provider
JEV_PROVIDER.description: Where judgments are served: openrouter (default), typesafe (direct, key from console.typesafe.ai), or custom (set jev.url / jev.model in ~/.config/semantic-compact/config.json)

JEV_API_KEY.title: API key
JEV_API_KEY.description: API key for the chosen provider. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.
